New Game

You are creating a multiplayer game. Your empire name and race below are yours; the other players choose theirs when they join. Set the player spots and AI opponents under Opponents, and privacy and custom races under Advanced Options.

AI Opponents

Add or remove AI opponents and set each one's empire name, race and intelligence level. Every opponent starts with a pre-generated empire name you can change. Choose Random for a race or intelligence level and the game picks one when the galaxy is created. Your saved custom races are listed under Custom Races in each race menu.

Technology Research Matrix & Tech Tree

Research is paid in Resources. The share of your annual Resources set on the Economy screen flows into the field chosen here. When a field collects enough Resources it advances one level, and the next level costs more.

Empire Economy & Budget Allocation

Resources are your industrial labor: they come from colonists and operating factories. Ore (Ironium, Boranium, Germanium) is the raw matter dug up by mines. Everything you build needs both. Split your Resources between research and planetary manufacturing; unspent manufacturing Resources are lost. Total must equal 100%.

⚙ Advanced Options

Tick any option to add it to this game. These settings are locked in when you press Create Galaxy and are saved with the game.
Multiplayer Options
4 to 64 characters. Give it to the players you want; anyone you invite by email or username joins without it.
Off: every empire uses one of the six built-in races. On: custom races from the Race Wizard may be played, by these rules:
When a player has had the turn for longer than this, any other player can skip it. The skipped empire follows its standing orders for that turn.
Game Options

🧬 Custom Races

Design your own races with the Race Wizard. Saved races appear under Custom Races in Choose Race and in every AI opponent's race list. They are kept in this browser and copied into every saved game that uses them.

🏆 Victory Conditions

Tick the conditions that can win the game and set their values. Owning 60% of all planets is ticked to start with. With nothing ticked the game never ends on its own. Every empire, AI included, is judged by the same rules.
Own at least % of all planets (10 to 100)
Reach level (1 to 26) in of the 6 fields (1 to 6)
Score of at least (1,000 to 1,000,000)
Have a score at least % higher than the second place empire (1 to 1,000)
Own at least capital ships (2 to 1,000)
Have the highest score after years (10 to 1,000,000)
A winner must meet of the above criteria to win
At least years must pass before a winner is declared (10 to 1,000,000)

Autobuild Rules

When a planet's build queue runs empty, the game reads this list from the top. The first rule that applies adds an item to the queue and the planet carries on building in the same turn. A rule is skipped if the planet cannot pay the Ore for one unit, so a planet never queues something it cannot build. Rules apply to every planet of your empire; a single planet can switch Autobuild off in its Production Queue panel.

🤝 Diplomacy

Your stance toward each empire is your own decision and the others are not told. Friend: you never attack them, your minefields do not hit them, they refuel at your docks and may use your stargates. Neutral: attacked only by battle plans set to Neutrals & Enemies or Everyone; patrols leave them alone. Enemy: attacked by every battle plan and by patrols. Changes count from the next year played out.

💣 Minefields

Your fields are blue, friends' yellow, neutral and enemy fields red. You see another empire's field when its center is inside your planet-penetrating scanner range, when one of your fleets is inside it, or when you have hit it before and its center is inside your normal scanner range.
